course_id.description: UUIDv4, allocated once. Immutable. Never derived from title/category/path.

normalized_title.description: NFC + casefold + punctuation-stripped, for deterministic matching

slug.description: Directory name, unique within category only

category_path.description: Normalized category path relative to courses_root

rel_path.description: Path relative to courses_root; changes on move

normalized_aliases.description: Globally unique across all courses; enforced by registry

topic_id.description: Legacy topic_id preserved verbatim so pre-migration events remain resolvable
